description: City Z PBR material set. Every entry is Poly Haven CC0 and pulls three maps at 4k: Diffuse (sRGB albedo), nor_gl (OpenGL-convention tangent normal) and arm (AO in R, roughness in G, metalness in B). The packed `arm` map is deliberate: Three.js MeshStandardMaterial reads aoMap/roughnessMap/metalnessMap from R/G/B of one texture, so one upload serves three slots.

entries.name: Window Glass (procedural)
entries.notes: Poly Haven publishes no glass texture (verified against all 849 texture ids). Window glass is a shader-parameter material: it needs the scene environment map (see hdris.json) and no albedo/normal/orm maps at all.

entries.name: Road Markings (procedural)
entries.notes: Poly Haven publishes no lane-marking / painted-tarmac texture (verified against all 849 texture ids; asphalt_pit_lane and asphalt_track are unmarked tarmac). Lane lines are generated as an alpha decal atlas by the processing workstream.
